name: 01-first-poll-uses-default-and-advances-to-max
description: First run: no stored watermark, so the query uses the default expression YESTERDAY (a SOQL date literal). Both returned contacts are logged by Batch_Step (the connector's HashMap order, SOAP date format) and the watermark becomes the MAX LastModifiedDate.

source.reference: salesforce-data-synchronization-using-watermarking-and-batch-processing/src/main/app/watermarking.xml (flow triggerFlow: poll fixed-frequency 10 s, watermark variable=timestamp default-expression=YESTERDAY selector=MAX selector-expression=#[payload.LastModifiedDate], sfdc:query 'SELECT Id,Name,LastModifiedDate FROM Contact WHERE LastModifiedDate > #[flowVars['timestamp']]'; batch:job watermarkingBatch Batch_Step logger 'Contact recently modified: #[payload]'); README 'How it Works'

queryParams.q: SELECT Id,Name,LastModifiedDate FROM Contact WHERE LastModifiedDate > YESTERDAY
SELECT Id,Name,LastModifiedDate FROM Contact WHERE LastModifiedDate > YESTERDAY
